summary: @GitHub in Slack and Teams now supports working across multiple repositories in a single conversation. Whether you’re creating issues, opening pull requests, or investigating bugs, you can work across repositories without switching conversations.
takeaways: Improved reliability: We’ve made several improvements to reduce errors, improve task startup, and help @GitHub recover more smoothly from interruptions in Slack and Teams.
Additional improvements We’ve also made several improvements to GitHub in Slack and Microsoft Teams: More natural conversations: Mention @GitHub anywhere in your message, not just at the beginning.
Better Slack conversation context: @GitHub can use shared Slack messages and threads as context, making it easier to reference discussions without copying and pasting details.
